label: About
title: About Where the Body Presses
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1218 recent saved-signal files and 835 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @katiewav: just finished REANIMAL absolutely gorgeous game and Colourform, plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Where the Body Presses: Source-fidelity recovery pass 1: build a new composition from the concrete source fragments. Require at least one structural change to arrangement, grouping/object count, or spatial logic; scale shifts, cropping and surface distress alone do not count. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Green-grey glazing enclosed by the large right window frame, Chipped and notched foreground bench fascia, and Narrow curved highlight along the foreground knee.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
